rows=[list(map(int,l.split())) for l in mstr.strip().split("\n")]
B62={(a,b):rows[i][j] for i,a in enumerate(aas) for j,b in enumerate(aas)}
def sc(a,b): return B62.get((a,b),-1)
def align(q,s,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,mm=len(q),len(s); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,mm+1),NEG); Ix=np.full((n+1,mm+1),NEG); Iy=np.full((n+1,mm+1),NEG)
    M[0,0]=0; Ix[1:,0]=go+ge*np.arange(0,n); Iy[0,1:]=go+ge*np.arange(0,mm)
    SM=np.array([[sc(a,b) for b in s] for a in q],float)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        prev=np.maximum.reduce([M[i-1,:mm],Ix[i-1,:mm],Iy[i-1,:mm]])
        M[i,1:]=prev+SM[i-1]
        Ix[i,1:]=np.maximum(M[i-1,1:]+go, Ix[i-1,1:]+ge)
        row=np.full(mm+1,NEG); row[0]=Iy[i,0]
        for j in range(1,mm+1): row[j]=max(M[i,j-1]+go, row[j-1]+ge)
        Iy[i]=row
    i,j=n,mm; st=int(np.argmax([M[i,j],Ix[i,j],Iy[i,j]])); mp={}
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if st==0:
            mp[i-1]=j-1; st=int(np.argmax([M[i-1,j-1],Ix[i-1,j-1],Iy[i-1,j-1]])); i-=1; j-=1
        elif st==1: st=0 if M[i-1,j]+go>=Ix[i-1,j]+ge else 1; i-=1
        else: st=0 if M[i,j-1]+go>=Iy[i,j-1]+ge else 2; j-=1
    return mp
url=("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene:GLOD4+AND+taxonomy_id:7742+AND+fragment:false"
     "&fields=accession,organism_name,sequence&format=json&size=500")
recs=[(x['primaryAccession'],x['organism']['scientificName'],x['sequence']['value'])
      for x in requests.get(url,timeout=240).json()['results']]
best={}
for acc,org,s in recs:
    if org not in best or len(s)>len(best[org][1]): best[org]=(acc,s)
POS={8:'H',70:'E',201:'R',254:'C',55:'K',33:'R',88:'G',126:'Y'}
tab=[]
for org,(acc,s) in sorted(best.items()):
    mp=align(ISO2,s)
    r={'organism':org,'acc':acc,
       'pct_id':round(100*sum(1 for qi,sj in mp.items() if ISO2[qi]==s[sj])/len(ISO2),1)}
    for p in POS: r[f'p{p}']= s[mp[p-1]] if (p-1) in mp else '-'
    tab.append(r)
df=pd.DataFrame(tab)
print(f"n_orthologs = {len(df)} vertebrate species; pct_id range {df.pct_id.min()}-{df.pct_id.max()}")
cons={}
for p,h in POS.items():
    col=df[f'p{p}']; gapped=(col=='-').sum()
    frac=100*(col==h).sum()/max(1,(col!='-').sum()); cons[p]=frac
    print(f"  pos {p} (human {h}): {frac:.1f}% identical over {(col!='-').sum()} aligned ({gapped} gaps) | {dict(col.value_counts().head(4))}")
